description: This PHP class 'PendingTimesheetSummary' implements the 'ActionSummary' interface, encapsulating logic to represent a summary of pending timesheets requiring approval within the OrangeHRM system. It constructs search filter parameters for employee timesheets based on accessible employee numbers and user role permissions, and provides methods to retrieve the group ID, group name, and count of pending actions.

classes.name: PendingTimesheetSummary
classes.description: A class representing a summary of pending employee timesheets for approval, providing counts and categorization within the timesheet approval workflow.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with accessible employee numbers, setting up filter parameters and actionable states for timesheet approval.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this action summary group, fixed at 2.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group, 'Timesheets To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending timesheets needing approval based on the constructed filter parameters.
